videos.title: Paranormal State: Freshmen Fear
videos.overview: A young female student claims to have seen a ghost in her dorm room.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Paranormal Intervention
videos.overview: Carol Ann stays awake every night taping the voices of the dead. PRS cuts their winter break short to help her curtail her obsession and close this doorway to the dead--for good.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Beer, Wine and Spirits
videos.overview: Brian's bar has a cranky customer who's got a bad habit of breaking wine glasses. Charlie has been dead since prohibition.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Lady Vampire
videos.overview: PRS investigates a case involving single mom, Dawn, and her 5-year-old daughter, both of whom are tormented by the appearance of a hag they call "lady vampire."

videos.title: Paranormal State: Shape Shifter
videos.overview: PRS travels to Shapleigh, Maine where a woman and her daughter are reporting attacks from a winged creature with sharp teeth. Psychic Chip Coffey arrives and senses a half-human, half animal presence.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Boy Pushed Me
videos.overview: Bruce and Danielle are terrified by an EVP recorded in their Indiana home stating "Kill them." Even more chilling, their toddler son survived a fall out of a window only to tell his parents, "Boy pushed me."

videos.title: Paranormal State: The Fury
videos.overview: Kathy, her two daughters and her new husband, "Farmer" thought they had the perfect, quiet life deep in the mountains of West Virginia.

videos.title: Paranormal State: The Basement
videos.overview: A history of violence may connect the spiritual activity in Heidi's Ohio home to a long run of misery and cruelty.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Supernatural Seduction
videos.overview: PRS investigates the Campbell House, where the Innkeeper and guests claim to have sexual encounters with a spirit who has deep ties to a family tragedy.

videos.title: Paranormal State: I Am Six
videos.overview: Laura has felt oppressed by a violent spirit ever since she heard a chilling EVP in the fall of 2007. The 26-year-old claims she's been beaten, choked, even forcibly submerged.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Haunted Connection
videos.overview: P.R.S. is called in to help a young mother tormented by an otherworldly connection to a teenage girl murdered in her neighborhood years ago. Could she have psychic ability or is there a more sinister force at work?

videos.title: Paranormal State: Ghosts of the Forgotten
videos.overview: The PRS investigation into the haunted Lake County Poor House becomes a journey through one PRS team members? troubled past.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Man of the House
videos.overview: PRS is called to help a grandmother and her frightened grandson when renovations on her 19th century house stir up the pipe-smoking specter of a former tenant named Alfred.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Shadow Caster
videos.overview: PRS investigates an Alabama home where clients, Georgiana and her two daughters, are so terrified, they moved out after only 18 months. They have seen shadow figures, been touched and have a recorded EVP stating, "Look at me, get out of here."

videos.title: Paranormal State: Satan's Soldier
videos.overview: Mark and Kim can't sleep through the racket caused by unseen forces in their central Indiana home. When PRS and Psychic/Medium Michelle Belanger discover what appears to be blood in the basement, they investigate a history of violence in the home.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Dark Practice
videos.overview: Brenda is terrified by a dark hooded figure spotted in her West Virginia home. The same entity allegedly tormented her late husband. PRS and Psychic/Medium Michelle Belanger help Brenda before she slips into the same abyss as her late husband.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Haunted Ranch
videos.overview: PRS saddles up to a remote ranch in Hunt, Texas where black shadows are being spotted and animals harmed. What's more, a mysterious crop circle has formed on the property and the horses refuse to cross it.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Paranormal Detour
videos.overview: With time off between cases, Ryan suggests to the PRS team they choose a random town to investigate. They roll into St. Helens, Oregon, home of Twilight, where they learn about the long history of the paranormal in the area.

videos.title: Paranormal State: First Contact
videos.overview: Washington State, a hotbed of unexplained paranormal activity. Between possible UFOs in the sky and winged creatures in the woods, Ryan and his team are forced to face their fears and deal with the question: Are we truly alone in the universe?

videos.title: Paranormal State: Church of the Damned
videos.overview: Jason and his family can no longer do renovations of an abandoned Kansas church, especially after they found their father in the basement crying and frightened because of the menacing activity.

videos.title: Paranormal State: The Fire
videos.overview: Christina has been experiencing paranormal activity ever since her father and step-mother were murdered near Columbus, OH last year. PRS and psychic/medium?Chip Coffey delve into a open murder case and wind up exposing a family divide.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Spirits of the Slave Dungeon
videos.overview: Ryan books a two-night case in a real haunted jail in Charleston, SC, but PRS soon realizes the spirits themselves are being held there against their will and subjected to an unjust form of torture.

videos.title: Paranormal State: The Name
videos.overview: Ryan Buell and company set out on one of their most dangerous cases to date - to help a single mother who is experiencing paranormal activity in a home that was once the site of brutal murder.

videos.title: Paranormal State: The Asylum
videos.overview: PRS explores a New York State Prison that was once a mental asylum. Ryan and his team go behind bars to uncover the institution's paranormal past and present.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Desperate Households
videos.overview: When Julie and her family moved into their dream home in suburban New Jersey they quickly realized they were not alone.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Vendetta
videos.overview: P.R.S. investigates claims of supernatural revenge in the Pennsylvania Poconos. When a client's new boyfriend moves in, does the paranormal move in with him? Or did her ex put a hex on her house and the entire family?

videos.title: Paranormal State: Lost Souls
videos.overview: PRS and Psychic/medium Michelle Belanger investigate a Pennsylvania home; where a mother named Kathy and her son Michael have both felt the presence of a young boy and hear voices calling, "Mom?" but no one is there.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Hillary and her nine-year-old son Hunter are being harassed by a shadow presence in their Victorian home in Newburgh, Indiana. Trap doors in the basement reveal artifacts from a bygone era, and the clients have recorded persistent strange noises.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Woman in the Window
videos.overview: Ryan and his team lend paranormal assistance to a family who lives in a historic home that was once a part of the Underground Railroad. Does the answer to their haunting lie in the mysterious tunnels beneath the house?

videos.title: Paranormal State: The Knickerbocker
videos.overview: PRS checks into the Knickerbocker Hotel in Linesville, Pennsylvania where the owners are reporting strange noises and the appearance of phantom children in some of the rooms.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Laws of Attraction
videos.overview: When Paula's young autistic son Michael, with limited verbal skills uttered the words "Go away scary dead boy" -- it sent a chill up her spine.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Haunted Homecoming
videos.overview: Ryan brings PRS to his hometown of Sumter, SC to investigate a chilling case where a young boy was tragically shot and killed on a front doorstep while trick-or-treating on Halloween.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Smoke and Shadows
videos.overview: Sarah believes her Parkville, MD home has been invaded by a powerful force ever since her roommate Dennis moved in. PRS investigates claims that Dennis has been attacked by the entity, a possible poltergeist.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Permission To Do Harm
videos.overview: When a mirror levitates and shatters on its own, P.R.S. heeds the call to investigate a spirit that has been unleashed on an unsuspecting family. Ryan must track down the spirit and contain it before it does irreparable damage.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Sixth Sense
videos.overview: A worried mother calls the Paranormal Research Society to help her son Matthew, a boy who sees dead people. Matthew's story strikes a chord with team leader Ryan Buell who also experienced paranormal activity as a child.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Do Bad Things
videos.overview: After receiving a letter requesting PRS' help, Ryan and the team head to Ohio to help a grieving family and determine if the family's house contributed to the untimely death of a daughter.

videos.title: Paranormal State: Room & Board
videos.overview: The owners of a vacation lodge in the remote town of North Hudson, NY, feel their woodsy getaway is plagued by negative spirits.
